profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with a background in writing and graphic design with a decade of experience designing and building greenfield Rails applications. In recent roles, I've led architectural decisions with an emphasis on rapid prototyping, risk mitigation, and reducing institutional knowledge silos through clear, sustainable documentation. I enjoy working with Product to refine elaborate business problems into small achievable pieces and making sure everyone on the team is learning as we go.

GitHub: https://github.com/lortza
Blog: http://lortza.github.io/blog/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Engineering lead on several projects, setting implementation strategy, providing technical direction, and unblocking teammates
* Collaborate with Product to define practical, high-impact solutions within the constraints of data, timelines, and team resources
* Delivered complex greenfield features as sole engineer, including a Stripe-integrated payment system, asset version tracking, user role access UI, and UX optimizations for ChatGPT API workflows
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through thoughtfully code reviews and ongoing technical guidance, fostering growth and code quality across the team
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · hotwire · Test-Driven Development · Mentoring

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Lead team in the successful delivery of projects, making sure to get juniors in position for easy wins, mentorship, and learning opportunities
* Built new GraphQL API to house, calculate, and efficiently serve 6GB of complex Medicare pricing data from CMS.gov resources resulting in all new capabilities for the product
* Wrote thorough tests for complex queries, ensuring no behavioral surprises in production
* Occasionally managed various Azure environments for 2 applications and a set cloud-hosted databases with blue/green deployment
* Worked hand-in-hand with Product and UX to deliver small-scale experiments, resulting in quick feedback loops, informed product direction, and improved user experiences

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Initiated and fostered culture of documenting tribal knowledge into the wiki (instead of README) resulting in some of the most useful documentation seen by several developers new to the team
* Successfully led the team to safely remove 7 million bad db records and then the subsequent snapshots and backup tables we created for safety. Went off w/o a hitch. =D
* Deployed a refactor that reduced database lookups by 50% while reducing risk of string name lookup mistakes by replacing it with an identifier field
* Reduced code review delays and communication issues by introducing a suite of Slack emojis to indicate pull request needs and status. This fix was implemented across all dev teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer Contractor
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Graphic Designer, Writer, Editor
positions.description:
I work with small business owners and entrepreneurs to create a message that supports their mission and art to support those messages. I also edit book manuscripts and offer book layout services.
- As a forerunner in the small business movement, launched successful 6-year “Local First” campaign for Denver that was modeled by other regions
- Created branding, web design, wireframes, HTML markup, CMS customization support
- Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Wordpress, Drupal, Squarespace, Adobe CS4 & 5

positions.title: Co-Founder and Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Brought startup from spreadsheet to robust Rails app in 2 weeks by building
product aggregator MVP app
- Extracted data from multiple unique merchant XML datafeeds and standardized for our db (ETL)
- Maximized performance with efficient Postgres queries and offloading db updates to late night with rake tasks
- Tech Stack: Rails 4, Ruby 2.2, RSpec, Heroku, SendGrid, Rollbar, Devise, Ahoy, Git

positions.title: Jr Application Developer
positions.description:
- Fixed bugs and implemented new features for Fortune 500 client sites in legacy PHP codebases
- Deployed new clients sites to in-house hosting
- Wrote workflow docs for company wiki
- Tech Stack: PHP, jQuery, MySQL, RSpec, GitLab, VS

positions.title: Bike Mechanic Volunteer
positions.description:
- Cleaning, assembling, repairing, and tuning up bikes
- Instructing bicycle maintenance classes for women 
- Assisting customers with performing their own bicycle repairs
- Assisting in bicycle sales

positions.title: Graphic Designer & Production Data Manager
positions.description:
- Designed magazine layouts and ads for clients
- Built new sales pipeline tracker which provided previously unavailable sales data and automated ad file delivery notifications (a solution for the typical sore spot for any publication
- Tech Stack: SalesForce, Adobe CS4

positions.title: Systems Trainer & Workflow Processes Developer
positions.description:
In this position, I programmed communication systems for healthcare clients and trained staff how to use them. The process involved holding needs-assessment meetings (how do you want this system to work for you?) with hospital administrators, RNs, LPNs, and CNAs, collecting data and programming the system, and training the staff to use the system. Some required skills: reviewing floor plans, database information relationships, simple programming, technical writing, active listening, creating system work-arounds, public speaking, and training users at all skill levels.

- Programmed custom hospital staff/patient communication systems and trained staff
- Designed company workflow tools and processes resulting in clearer communications and a stronger team dynamic
- Tech Stack: MS Access, Excel

positions.title: Community Marketing & Mascot Management
positions.description: In this position, I managed receiving and delivering on requests for community support such as food donations and mascot appearances. Since Eat'n Park is a cornerstone restaurant in so many communities throughout Pennsylvania, we received hundreds of requests per week. In order to keep up, I built a database to track branded cookie donations and to plan mascot appearances, making my work 800% more efficient. With this efficiency we were able to increase the mascot fleet from 2 to 10 costumes, which increased program capacity from 52 to 230 performances per year and 90% cleaner costumes.

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description: Managing writers, writing articles, editing articles, and laying out newsletter

positions.title: Writing Tutor
positions.description: Working with many first-year and ESL students to improve their papers and overall understanding of good writing practices

volunteerExperiences.description: Working as a mechanic, a.k.a. wrencher, at the Bike Depot was delightful because I got to practice my skills, learn new things, and help to get more economically-challenged people onto bikes. Getting a person on a bike can mean the difference between being able to get to work or the grocery store or not, so this is very important to me. I'd spend my time doing tune-ups, organizing the shop, or helping people to fix their bikes. I even taught a women's mechanics class. So much good stuff happening there!

projects.title: ProductMatchr.com
projects.description:
ProductMatchr scours the internet to bring you the best clothing and gear deals in your size.

We are a tiny team of 3, building this Ruby on Rails application.

projects.title: Flicksonlists.com
projects.description: Flicksonlists.com is a movie list app made by Anne Richardson and Mike Vallano. It's built on Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL. Users can track the movies they've watched, save movies they want to watch in a list, share lists, look up movie and actor stats and more.
